data.helperPod.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: helper-pod
  labels:
    app: local-path-helper
    app.kubernetes.io/name: local-path-helper
spec:
  priorityClassName: system-node-critical
  tolerations:
    - operator: Exists
      effect: NoSchedule
    - operator: Exists
      effect: NoExecute
  containers:
    - name: helper-pod
      image: docker.io/kindest/local-path-helper:v20260131-7181c60a
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 25m
          memory: 32Mi
        limits:
          cpu: 200m
          memory: 128Mi
